subject: POC checkpoints, owners, and exec readout availability
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emily Ford <emily.ford@healthlytix.com>, Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@healthlytix.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Quick recap + proposed POC checkpoints (Healthlytix)

Emily / Rajiv — thanks for the call earlier. Short recap and clear next steps so we all have aligned expectations before we spin up the pilot environment.

Call highlights
- Primary objective: validate Redwood inference latency and cost at 2k concurrent users for triage workflows; must hit <250ms 95th for 512-token requests.
- Success criteria (agreed):
  1) Latency: 95th <= 250ms on tagged test traffic for three consecutive days.
  2) Throughput: sustain 2,000 concurrent sessions with <=10% error rate.
  3) Quality: no more than 8% drop vs baseline on your test prompts (we'll use the supplied 150 prompt set).
  4) Integration: secure VPC peering + KMS key integration completed.

Proposed POC plan & owners (attach: POC-plan-v1.pdf + evaluation-checklist.xlsx)
- Week 1 (Nov 23–27): Environment setup — Redwood infra team (Lauren) + Healthlytix infra (Rajiv). Deliverable: VPC peering + test harness.
- Week 2 (Nov 30–Dec 4): Ingest prompts, run smoke tests — Monica (CS) leads test-run, Emily to validate prompt set. Deliverable: smoke test report.
- Week 3 (Dec 7–11): Load & stability runs — Redwood runtime team (Monica) + Healthlytix ops. Deliverable: 3-day stability window.
- Week 4 (Dec 14–18): Final eval & readout prep — Karthik to coordinate exec summary and decision packet.

Decision process
- We propose an executive readout the week of Dec 21 with Healthlytix product and ops leads and our GTM + engineering sponsors. Readout will present measured KPIs, cost estimates, and recommended next contract step (Dedicated capacity proposal + 12-month commitment).

Action items (owners)
- Rajiv: confirm VPC CIDR and schedule time with your network team (owner: Rajiv).
- Lauren: provision test tenant and share SSH/credentials for test harness (owner: Lauren).
- Monica: prepare evaluation checklist and skeleton dashboards (owner: Monica).
- Emily: confirm the canonical prompt set (owner: Emily).
- Karthik: schedule exec readout slots; draft decision packet + pricing.

Proposed exec readout windows (please indicate preference)
- Tue Dec 22, 9:00–10:00 PST
- Wed Dec 23, 11:00–12:00 PST
- Mon Dec 28, 14:00–15:00 PST

I attached the POC plan + evaluation checklist for quick review and linked the HubSpot deal for tracking. If anything above needs to change we can adjust before provisioning.

Thanks — Karthik

---
Karthik Iyer | Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference
From: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@healthlytix.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Emily Ford <emily.ford@healthlytix.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposed POC checkpoints (Healthlytix)

Thanks, Karthik — this looks good. A couple quick notes from infra:
- I'll send VPC CIDR and initial firewall rules by EOD tomorrow.
- We're tight on the week of Dec 21 due to year-end freezes; can we favor the Dec 28 slot for exec readout? That gives us time to complete extended stability runs if needed.

Also, for the latency target: our internal baseline is ~220ms 95th right now. If Redwood hits 240ms that's acceptable but I'd like to see the full distribution in the dashboard (p50/p95/p99).

Rajiv
Network Engineering Manager
Healthlytix

Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposed POC checkpoints (Healthlytix)

Adding a few practical notes on the evaluation checklist and data we need from Healthlytix:
- Please provide: sample traffic trace (anonymized), expected token distribution, and the 150 prompt canonical file as CSV.
- We'll instrument token-level cost + latency dashboards and share a read-only link.
- For quality, we'll run A/B comparisons against your baseline with the supplied test set; Monica will own the pass/fail gating and will call out any sample regressions >8%.

I'm reserving time for smoke on Nov 30, please confirm harness access by then.

—Monica
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks — confirmed.
- I'll upload the prompt CSV and an anonymized sample trace to the Drive folder by Monday (21 Nov).
- Dec 28 works best for us for the executive readout. Please pencil that in and send a calendar invite when you have the exact time.

Emily

Great — Dec 28 locked. Calendar invite sent (Dec 28, 14:00–15:00 PST) with a short agenda: 1) summary of POC KPIs, 2) measured results, 3) cost estimate & recommended next step, 4) contract path.

Next steps before readout
- Monica: ensure dashboards include p50/p95/p99 and cost delta (owner: Monica).
- Rajiv: share CIDR + firewall rules (owner: Rajiv).
- Emily: upload artifacts to Drive (owner: Emily).
- Lauren: confirm test tenant credentials and run smoke on Nov 30 (owner: Lauren).
- Karthik: draft decision packet and attach initial cost per 1,000 requests (owner: Karthik).

Attaching final POC plan and checklist again. I'll also drop the HubSpot link in the invite for easy reference.

Appreciate the quick alignment — talk soon.

Karthik
